decisive_finding.cause: EventStore::open_bound rejects a symlinked file and immediate parent but accepts a symlink in an earlier ancestor. The resulting store path resolves through attacker-controlled ancestry instead of failing closed.
decisive_finding.coverage_gap: validator/tests/observability_contract/races_paths.rs covers only the file and immediate-parent symlink cases

corrective_action: Validate the complete existing ancestor chain without following symlinks before binding or creating a store, add the exact nested-ancestor regression plus substitution controls, and re-run all local/query/privacy/export/race tests. Do not rely on canonicalization that silently follows the symlink.
claim_ceiling: The observability bytes remain an unaccepted source candidate. Public API/CLI/product wiring, live export, node closure, readiness, release, and completion remain withheld.
no_claim_statement: This REWORK stops at the first material filesystem trust-boundary defect and raises no product or completion claim.
